# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

Participation in this project should remain respectful, constructive, and focused on improving the software and its documentation.

Examples of expected behavior include:

- giving technical feedback without personal attacks;
- respecting different experience levels and viewpoints;
- keeping discussions relevant to the project;
- handling security and sensitive-data concerns responsibly.

Harassment, discriminatory language, threats, doxxing, or publication of private or sensitive information are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit, remove, or reject contributions and interactions that violate these expectations. Serious or repeated violations may result in temporary or permanent exclusion from project spaces.

Reports about conduct should be sent privately to the maintainer rather than posted publicly when doing so would expose sensitive information.
